mapper.insert: insert into trade_order (out_trade_no, customer_id, goods_id, goods_title, goods_price, goods_image, goods_description, quantity, total_amount, order_status, snapshot_id, create_date) values (#{outTradeNo}, #{customerId}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsTitle}, #{goodsPrice}, #{goodsImage}, #{goodsDescription}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, 1, #{snapshotId}, current_date)
mapper.update: update trade_order set order_status = 2 where order_status = 1 and timestampdiff(MINUTE, create_time, now()) > 20
update trade_order set order_status = 2 where order_status = 1 and out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}
mapper.delete: delete from trade_order where order_id = #{orderId} and order_status = 2
mapper.select: select ((select count(*) from trade_order where customer_id = #{customerId} and create_date = current_date() and order_status < 3) >= 10) OR ((select count(*) from trade_order where customer_id = #{customerId} and refund_date = current_date() and order_status = 4) >= 5) as illegal
select IFNULL(sum(total_amount), 0) as totalAmount, count(*) as totalCount, IFNULL(sum(quantity), 0) as totalQuantity from trade_order where customer_id = #{id} and order_status in (3, 5, 6)
select * from trade_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} limit 1
select customer_id from trade_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} limit 1
select out_refund_no as outRefundNo from trade_order where order_id = #{orderId} limit 1
select count(1) from trade_order where customer_id = #{customerId} and snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} limit 1
select count(1) > 0 from trade_order where order_id = #{orderId} and customer_id = #{customerId} limit 1

/* SHARDINGSPHERE_HINT: WRITE_ROUTE_ONLY=true */ select o.order_id as orderId, o.quantity as n1, (select count(*) from med_exam_appointment where order_id = o.order_id and status = 3) as n2 from trade_order o join med_exam_appointment a on o.order_id = a.order_id where a.appointment_no = #{appointmentNo}
mapper.update: update trade_order set out_refund_no = #{refundNo}, refund_date = current_date, refund_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and order_status = 3
update trade_order set order_status = 4 where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and order_status = 3
